Metadata.description: An AI coaching product for Ironman trainees

AthletePage.tagline: Your Coach is ready when you are.
AthletePage.noAthlete: We couldn't load your profile. Please sign out and try again.

Information.title: Information
Information.subtitle: Your training and bodily information
Information.noAthlete: We couldn't load your profile. Please sign out and try again.
Information.empty: Nothing to show yet — this page grows as your training does. Complete a session and it starts filling in.
Information.emptyRange: No readings in this range — pick a longer one.
Information.graphNote: each line is scaled to its own range — compare shapes over time, not values
Information.compareHint: pick 2 or more — same-kind comparisons tell the progression story
Information.compareNote: How it felt, next to what was done.
Information.periodNote: each block is {n} {n, plural, one {week} other {weeks}} of the selected range

Equipment.title: Equipment
Equipment.lede: What you train on, so your Coach can be specific.
Equipment.emptyTitle: Your Coach doesn't know what you ride yet
Equipment.emptyBody: Add your bike, your shoes and your watch. It takes a minute, and it lets the Coach talk about your actual gear instead of gear in general.
Equipment.errorIdentifier: That looks like an email address or a phone number. Your Coach reads this text, so leave contact details out of it.
Equipment.detailsPlaceholder: Optional — setup, size, anything the Coach should know

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.lede: Durable preferences your Coach reads every time it plans for you.
Settings.noAthlete: We couldn't load your profile. Please sign out and try again.
Settings.languageNote: Applies to the app and your Coach right away. Sports terms like RPE and Zone 2 stay in English either way.
Settings.raceTargetNote: The race you are training for. Everything in your plan is built backwards from it.
Settings.communicationStyleNote: How you like to be coached, in your own words. Your Coach reads this to set its tone.
Settings.communicationStylePlaceholder: e.g. Direct and to the point — I don't need reassurance, just the plan.
Settings.weeklySessionDayNote: When your Coach opens next week's plan for you to look over.
Settings.fixedConstraintsNote: Your Coach plans around these automatically, every week.
Settings.sharingIntro: {name} is your Head Coach. What they can see is controlled here.
Settings.sharingAlwaysOnNote: Your calendar, sessions, statuses and move history. A Head Coach who can't see the plan isn't a coach — sever the link instead if that's what you want.
Settings.sharingReportsLabel: Session Reflections, Check-in data & profile stats
Settings.sharingReportsNote: What you reported about your own body.
Settings.sharingTranscriptsNote: What you told the AI, unguarded. Off by default.
Settings.severConfirmBody: This cuts all access, including history, right away. {name} would need a new invite to relink.
Settings.severed: Link severed — you're back to training solo.

Roster.title: Roster
Roster.subtitle: The athletes you coach.
Roster.notACoach: You don't have a coach account.

Briefing.title: Coach Briefing
Briefing.subtitle: Ask the Coach about this athlete.
Briefing.intro: The Coach has read this athlete's data — open a briefing to hear its read and ask questions.
Briefing.inputLabel: Ask the Coach about this athlete
Briefing.unsafeContent: Something in this athlete's training notes looks like an email address or phone number. The Coach can't read that, so this briefing can't be built until it's edited out.

Auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
Auth.error: That didn't work. Check your details and try again.

Calendar.emptyBody: Once your Coach has planned your first week, it appears on this grid.
Calendar.bouncePastDay: That day has already happened — sessions only move forward within the week.
Calendar.bounceOtherWeek: Sessions move within their own Mon–Sun week. Ask your Coach to reshape the week.
Calendar.bounceFrozen: This session is already completed — the training record is immutable.

SessionDrawer.title: Session
SessionDrawer.readOnlyNote: Content is set by your Coach — you can move or skip it.
SessionDrawer.retroNote: Past day — this will be logged as already completed.

Garmin.imported: {count, plural, one {# session imported} other {# sessions imported}}
Garmin.error: Couldn't read that file. Try a .fit or .gpx export.
Garmin.errorNotAFitFile: That doesn't look like a .fit file. In Garmin Connect, open the activity and choose Export Original — a renamed file won't work.
Garmin.errorCorrupt: That .fit file is damaged or incomplete. Download it from Garmin Connect again and re-upload.
Garmin.errorNoSessions: That file read fine but held no activity. Export the activity itself, not a summary or a course.
Garmin.errorEmpty: That file is empty. Pick the .fit or .gpx you exported from Garmin Connect.
Garmin.errorNotAuthenticated: You've been signed out. Sign in and upload again — nothing was lost.

ThemeToggle.switch: Switch theme: light, dark, or system

Onboarding.nextValue: Your first Week Plan is on the calendar
Onboarding.qExperience: How many Ironman-distance races have you completed?
Onboarding.qRaceSub: Include the name and approximate date
Onboarding.availableHours: How many hours a week can you train?
Onboarding.qConstraints: Any days you can never train?
Onboarding.weeklyDaySub: When do you typically review your week?

CoachThread.title: Coach
CoachThread.offerBody: It's your planning day. I've read how your body's been — want to look at next week together?

CoachChat.emptyBody: Nutrition, a session you're unsure about, how you're feeling — I've got your plan and your history in front of me.
CoachChat.clearReference: Remove this session from the conversation
CoachChat.consentRequired: Your Coach is paused until you agree to how your data is processed.
CoachChat.unsafeContent: A note or a piece of gear you have saved contains what looks like an email address or phone number. Your Coach cannot read that. Edit it out and try again.

WeeklySession.title: Weekly Session
WeeklySession.intro: Your once-a-week sit-down with your Coach — review the week and plan the next.
WeeklySession.proposalTitle: Save this week to your calendar?
WeeklySession.proposalIntro: Your Coach suggests this plan. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
WeeklySession.proposalPending: {count, plural, one {Coach proposed # session} other {Coach proposed # sessions}} — save or cancel when ready.
WeeklySession.proposalStale: This plan has rolled into a new day. Cancel it and ask your Coach for a fresh week.
WeeklySession.planned: {count, plural, =0 {Plan saved — a rest week} one {Plan saved — # session} other {Plan saved — # sessions}}
WeeklySession.ended: This Weekly Session is done. Your plan is on the calendar.
WeeklySession.consentRequired: Your Coach is paused until you agree to how your data is processed.
WeeklySession.coachUnavailable: Your Coach didn't answer that one. Nothing was lost — send it again.
WeeklySession.unsafeContent: Something saved in your training — a note or a piece of gear — looks like an email address or phone number. Your Coach can't read that. Edit it out and try again.

Messaging.title: Coaching Channel
Messaging.emptyBody: Messages between you, your Head Coach, and the AI Coach will show up here.

NotFound.title: This page doesn't exist
NotFound.body: The link may be old, or the address slightly off. Your training is where you left it.

ErrorPage.title: That didn't load
ErrorPage.body: Something went wrong on our side. Your training data is safe — try again, and if it keeps happening, come back in a moment.

Narration.multiLead: A few things changed in your plan while you were away:
